pass_semantics: every current selection-bearing learned lane is traced to validation, every registered agent/restart/seed available to the active claim is reported with median IQR and worst quartile, and hindsight test-best diagnostics never alter the frozen candidate

selection_contract.distribution_rule: linear q1 median q3; IQR=q3-q1; worst quartile contains ceil(n/4) lowest higher-is-better or highest lower-is-better units

selection_registry.selection_stage: validation checkpoint within each agent; no agent selection
selection_registry.evaluation_scope: all five pairs on all primary and confirmation seeds

selection_registry.candidate_census: 6 families plus all 5x2 neural restart scans
selection_registry.evaluation_scope: all six families on eight seeds
selected restart only; nonselected evaluation unavailable
all three restarts on primary and confirmation seeds

selection_registry.selection_stage: validation-only restart then smallest eligible dimension
selection_registry.evaluation_scope: all validation candidates and best-per-dimension evaluation

selection_registry.candidate_census: frozen standard, all 5 MF, teacher, recurrence, student
selection_registry.evaluation_scope: all strategies on all 8 primary and 4 confirmation seeds

nmf_directional.claim_use: all-agent directional distribution; never best-agent performance

legacy_student_predecessor.missing_evidence: nonselected legacy restart weights/evaluation metrics were not retained; no hindsight test-best restart can be computed
legacy_student_predecessor.claim_decision: retain as validation-only historical method evidence; active low-dimensional student selection is audited separately from T4.4.3

fresh_teacher.selection_rule: maximum best validation selection score; evaluation and confirmation remain blind

low_dimensional_student.selection_rule: smallest dimension within frozen relative-plus-absolute validation tolerance

audit_summary.legacy_all_candidate_evaluation_gap: T4.1.5 nonselected restart evaluation unavailable; predecessor is superseded and does not support a best-restart performance claim

claim_boundary.allowed: validation-only model selection, all-unit distribution summaries, worst-quartile outcomes, and explicit hindsight selection-bias diagnostics
claim_boundary.forbidden: best-of-N test selection, selected-agent-only reporting, optimizer optimality, universal memory benefit, physical-memory LER, device, RTL, FPGA, board, or experiment
